title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Is Down On Disappointing Q2 Sales Forecast
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) Is Down On Disappointing Q2 Sales Forecast 2/2/2018 9:47 AM ET 
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported first quarter EPS of $3.89 after the bell Thursday, up from $3.36 a year ago. Analysts expected EPS of $3.86. Revenues rose to $88.29 billion from $78.35 billion last year. Analysts had predicted revenues of $87.28 billion. 
Looking forward to the second quarter, Apple expects revenue between $60 billion and $62 billion. The consensus estimate is for revenues of $65.73 billion. 
Apple has been losing ground since the open Friday and is now down 3.39 at $164.39. 
by RTT Staff Writer
